children: RNS Number : 1658D  Together Financial Services Limited  13 November 2026

Together Financial Services Limited ("Together" or the "Group") announces that it will present its results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 via audio webcast at 14:00 GMT on Thursday 19 November 2026.

The presentation for analysts and investors will be followed by a question and answer session. The presentation slides will be available on the Group’s investor relations website Results, Reports & Presentations | Together Investors ahead of the webcast.
To register for the webcast, please use the following link:
Participants may also join the presentation via conference call:
Kate Grimoldby, Director of Corporate Affairs

Together has been helping people realise their property ambitions for over 50 years. As a specialist secured lender, it combines expertise, industry knowledge and a common-sense approach to consider customers’ individual circumstances.

The Group provides a wide range of flexible lending products across mainland UK, including residential and buy-to-let mortgages, bridging loans, commercial and semi-commercial mortgages and loans, auction finance and development funding. All applications are considered on their merits, helping individuals, SMEs, businesses and property investors turn their ambitions into reality.
Based in Cheadle, Cheshire, Together employs more than 900 colleagues and has a loan book of £8.5 billion.
Together is the trading name of Together Financial Services Limited, which has its registered office address at Lake View, Lakeside, Cheadle, Cheshire SK8 3GW.
